changelog:
v2.9.7 - Screen Recorder

- NEW Screen Recorder: native recording with MAX (60fps/24Mbps), HIGH (1080p/16Mbps) and WHATSAPP (720p/6Mbps) presets.
- Send as DOCUMENT = WhatsApp sends the ORIGINAL file, zero quality loss.
- DIRECT send from the app: post recordings to your WhatsApp Status or any number's chat without opening WhatsApp.
- Pause/resume from the notification, recordings gallery with play, rename, delete.
